swarm-architect.description: Plans a complete landing page as a structured BuildPlan.

swarm-section.description: Builds one isolated page section as a structured SectionPatch.

swarm-critic.description: Reviews a rendered page and returns safe structured fixes.

swarm-refiner.description: Refines one section as a specialist (layout, copy, media, style or content).

swarm-editor.description: Applies a precise user-requested change to nodes owned by a specific agent.

swarm-section-planner.description: Plans a new page section to insert into an existing page.

swarm-site-architect.description: Plans an institutional multi-page website as a structured SitePlan.
